verdict.rationale: dlt is a data-loading library/pipeline tool, not an AI agent with its own tool-use loop that would consume external MCP servers; the evidence shows dlt instead exposes its own MCP server for coding agents to use (agent-as-client role, not dlt-as-client), which is a different axis. Asking whether dlt itself plugs in MCP servers to use their tools is a category error for this kind of product.
